timeline.label: c. 2500 BCE

timeline.label: c. 633

timeline.event: A Portuguese fleet under Afonso de Albuquerque attacks Khor Fakkan
Britain and the coastal sheikhs sign the General Maritime Treaty
Maktoum bin Butti settles at Dubai Creek, founding the Al Maktoum line
The Perpetual Maritime Truce gives the Trucial Coast its name
Gulf pearling collapses amid the Depression and Japanese cultured pearls
timeline.label: 1930s

timeline.event: Abu Dhabi ships its first cargo of crude oil from Das Island
Sheikh Zayed becomes Ruler of Abu Dhabi
Britain announces it will withdraw its forces from the Gulf
Six emirates form the United Arab Emirates
Ras Al Khaimah joins the federation as its seventh emirate
The Gulf Cooperation Council is founded at a summit in Abu Dhabi
Emirates airline makes its first flights from Dubai
The sail-shaped Burj Al Arab hotel opens in Dubai

places.name: Abu Dhabi
places.clue: The UAE's capital grew around Qasr Al Hosn, a fort built to guard the island's freshwater well.

places.name: Burj Khalifa
places.clue: Dubai's 828 m tower became the world's tallest building when it opened in 2010.

places.name: Al Ain
places.clue: This oasis 'Garden City' on the Omani border became the UAE's first UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2011.

places.name: Liwa Oasis
places.clue: A crescent of date-palm villages on the edge of the Empty Quarter, ancestral home of the Bani Yas.

places.name: Jebel Jais
places.clue: Ras Al Khaimah's lofty Hajar peak, home to a zipline certified as the world's longest in 2018.

places.name: Sir Bani Yas Island
places.clue: Sheikh Zayed's island wildlife reserve, where Arabian oryx roam near an ancient Christian monastery.

places.name: Barakah Nuclear Power Plant
places.clue: The Arab world's first nuclear power station, with four reactors on Abu Dhabi's western coast.

places.name: Mleiha
places.clue: Sharjah's desert archaeological site spans the Stone Age to a pre-Islamic town that minted its own coins.

places.name: Al Bidya Mosque
places.clue: A small mud-brick and stone mosque in Fujairah, often called the oldest mosque in use in the UAE.

places.name: Madinat Zayed
places.clue: Main town of Abu Dhabi's Al Dhafra region, host of a famous camel festival and beauty contest.
